name: Cochinita Pibil
author: corerat on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 7 oz achiote paste (annatto paste, commercial is fine)
1 cup sour orange juice (or ½ cup vinegar + ½ cup regular orange juice)

steps: Line a baking dish with banana leaves, letting them overhang the sides. Place pork on the leaves.
Dissolve achiote paste in sour orange juice and mix in all spices. Coat the pork thoroughly with this marinade.
Marinate in refrigerator for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Pour melted lard over the marinated pork.
Wrap tightly in banana leaves, cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 1½ hours or until meat is fork-tender and almost falling apart.
For the salsa, mix all ingredients and let rest for at least 3 hours.
Shred the cooked pork and serve wrapped in the same banana leaves, accompanied by the salsa and fresh tortillas.
